note: bibcite_export exports bibcite_reference entities in any registered bibcite_format. Single-reference route /bibcite/export/{bibcite_format}/{entity_type}/{entity} (permission access bibcite export + entity view). Bulk Action plugins over bibcite_reference: bibcite_export_multiple ('Export reference') and bibcite_export_multiple_vbo ('Download Selected Citations'). Ships permission access bibcite export and action config entity system.action.bibcite_export_multiple. Since the module has no config object and actual export serialization is unreliable on this broken shared site, medium/hard cases are grounded in the module's real Action config entities (create/read - router-safe). NOTE: real export streaming uses the Symfony serializer which fatals here (broken commerce_cart_api normalizer), so cases assert on the action config entities rather than exported files.

evals.prompt: With bibcite_export enabled, what is the URL pattern to download a single bibcite reference in a given format (e.g. BibTeX), and what permission is required?
evals.expected_output: GET /bibcite/export/{bibcite_format}/{entity_type}/{entity} (e.g. /bibcite/export/bibtex/bibcite_reference/12). Requires the 'access bibcite export' permission plus view access to the reference.

evals.prompt: How can editors bulk-export bibcite references, and which action plugins does bibcite_export provide for that?
evals.expected_output: Via the export-all form (/admin/content/bibcite/reference/export), the export-selection form, or the bulk Action plugins bibcite_export_multiple ('Export reference') and bibcite_export_multiple_vbo ('Download Selected Citations', for Views Bulk Operations).

evals.prompt: Which bibliographic formats can bibcite_export write references to, and where do those formats come from?
evals.expected_output: Any enabled bibcite_format plugin whose encoder is a Symfony EncoderInterface - BibTeX, RIS, EndNote (7/X3/tagged), MARC - provided by the format submodules (bibcite_bibtex, bibcite_ris, bibcite_endnote, bibcite_marc). List via the format manager's getExportDefinitions().

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site there is a bibcite_export bulk action for exporting references. Inspect the action configuration and state which entity type it applies to.
evals.expected_output: It applies to bibcite_reference: the action bibcite_export_multiple (label 'Export reference', plugin bibcite_export_multiple, type bibcite_reference).

evals.prompt: A Views Bulk Operations export action for bibcite references exists on this site. Inspect the action configuration and give its exact label.
evals.expected_output: Its label is 'Download Selected Citations' (an action using the bibcite_export_multiple_vbo plugin over bibcite_reference).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, create the bibcite_export bulk action that exports selected references (the 'Export reference' action using the bibcite_export_multiple plugin over bibcite_reference). Apply it to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Create an action config entity: id bibcite_export_multiple, label 'Export reference', type bibcite_reference, plugin bibcite_export_multiple, empty configuration (Drupal\system\Entity\Action::create([...])->save()). This is the module's shipped action.

evals.prompt: Create a Views Bulk Operations action on this site that downloads selected bibcite references (using the bibcite_export_multiple_vbo plugin over bibcite_reference). Apply it to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Create an action config entity using plugin bibcite_export_multiple_vbo, type bibcite_reference (e.g. id bibcite_export_multiple_vbo, label 'Download Selected Citations'), then save.
